Impact: make output of available_filter_functions complete
phenomenon:
The first value of dyn_ftrace_total_info is not equal with
`cat available_filter_functions | wc -l`
root cause:
When printing functions with seq_printf in t_show
is just overflowed by current function record
won't be printed to user space through read buffer
just be dropped. So we can't see this function printing.
So
column2: every time the last function to fill the read buffer

column1: will be dropped.
This also applies to set_ftrace_filter if set_ftrace_filter has
more bytes than read buffer.
fix:
Through checking return value of seq_printf
this function doesn't be printed. Then we decrease position to force
this function to be printed next time
Another little fix is to show correct allocating pages count.
